# Vox Video Director

> An open-source agent skill that turns ONE topic into a controlled Vox-style paper-collage
> video package: concepts, template, beat map, GPT ImageGen still prompts, Google Omni motion
> prompts, Volcengine/Doubao narration, SRT captions, and local FFmpeg finishing. Works with any
> coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, and any SKILL.md agent).

## Core idea
You give a one-line topic. The skill drafts three concepts, you pick one, then you choose a
visual template. It produces an approved beat map, one still-image prompt per shot for GPT
ImageGen, and one motion prompt per shot for Google Omni. You generate the clips in Omni and
return them; the skill creates one consistent Volcengine/Doubao narration track, burns SRT
captions, and assembles a clean master with local FFmpeg. Music is a separate open-license
research or Suno-prompt handoff. Atlas, Agnes, and automatic remote video generation are not
part of the standard flow.

## What makes it different
- The look is a real editorial paper-collage (torn paper, halftone, cut-out headlines), not a moving PowerPoint.
- Topic-matched styling via theme presets + a per-video palette, not one house style.
- Human-in-the-loop and provider-agnostic: the video handoff is explicit and locally finished.
